possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card states only that the model was fine-tuned on databricks/databricks-dolly-15k, with no details on data collection, curation, or preprocessing, so training-data transparency is limited.

possible_risks.description: Historical and societal biases might be present in data that are used to train and fine-tune models. Biases can also be inherited from seed data or exacerbated by synthetic data generation methods.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuning on databricks-dolly-15k, a small human-written instruction dataset, can carry societal biases from its authors and examples into the model's text outputs.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: The checkpoint is fine-tuned only on databricks-dolly-15k, so its instruction-following behavior may not generalize to broader text-generation domains beyond that dataset's scope.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: The card lists only 'text-generation' as the primary task and gives no intended-use or out-of-scope guidance, leaving downstream risk assessment underspecified.
